decisions.decision: Keep the 10 professional service route identities separate from voice-discovery, general-intake and case-reference routes.
decisions.basis: The existing SERVICE_ROUTE_REGISTRY gives those destinations distinct route_kind values.

decisions.decision: Treat direct page snapshots and search-index excerpts as observations with reported crawl ages, not live HTTP verification.
decisions.basis: The retrieval tool reports cache ages; two direct reads returned cache miss while search results still exposed indexed excerpts.

decisions.decision: Keep current scope, current commercial terms and project-specific rights unconfirmed for all ten routes.
decisions.basis: The inspected pages are cached/indexed content, not current contracts or verified live project briefs.

decisions.decision: Retain radio-page rights-transfer wording only as a page-level observation.
decisions.basis: A service-page bullet is not a contract-level determination of medium, territory, term, exclusivity or sublicensing.

decisions.decision: Maintain the distinctions between full video production, video voice-over and presentation voice-over.
decisions.basis: Each has a separate route; their page snapshots describe different and partially overlapping work.

decisions.decision: Do not edit GEO outputs or the official website and do not deploy Pages.
decisions.basis: The task is a repository-only evidence audit and no external publication approval was given.
